#### Clase `CTkImage` (Línea 8)
- **Docstring:** _Class to store one or two PIl.Image.Image objects and display size independent of scaling:

light_image: PIL.Image.Image for light mode
dark_image: PIL.Image.Image for dark mode
size: tuple (<width>, <height>) with display size for both images

One of the two images can be None and will be replaced by the other image._
